description: This script is a Python-based utility for processing directory and file layouts, particularly for renaming directories and files, applying text replacements, and integrating with Sphinx documentation build process. It includes classes for handling filesystem operations, text replacements, and layout processing, as well as functions for setting up a Sphinx extension and command-line execution.

classes.name: DirHelper
classes.description: Helper class for directory operations such as checking if a directory exists, listing contents, walking directory tree, and removing directories.

classes.name: FileSystemHelper
classes.description: Helper class for file operations including opening files, joining paths, moving files, and checking existence.

classes.name: FileHandler
classes.description: Handles applying multiple text replacements to a file's contents.

classes.name: Remover
classes.description: Callable class to remove files or directories if they exist.

classes.name: ForceRename
classes.description: Renames a file/directory forcibly by removing the target before renaming.

classes.name: VerboseRename
classes.description: Renames a file/directory with verbose output to a stream.

classes.name: DirectoryHandler
classes.description: Handles renaming a directory by removing its first character.

classes.name: HandlerFactory
classes.description: Factory for creating file and directory handlers.

classes.name: OperationsFactory
classes.description: Factory for creating filesystem operation objects like renamers and replacers.

classes.name: Layout
classes.description: Represents a layout of directory and file handlers to process layout changes.

classes.name: NullLayout
classes.description: A layout that performs no operations.

classes.name: LayoutFactory
classes.description: Creates layout objects based on directory contents and options.

methods.name: sphinx_extension
methods.description: Sets up the layout processing as a Sphinx extension during build.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the Sphinx extension with necessary values and connects build-finished event.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Command-line entry point for processing a directory with options for verbosity and encoding.
